text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today is the "Summer Training 
Camp"— Intensive training to improve 
skills begins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Several months had passed since the Yayoi 
Sho, yet her troubled demeanor remained 
unchanged."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "This summer... I have to get faster..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Still, my legs are getting heavier and 
heavier...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp with Silence Suzuka 
has begun.
